errors.description: Button stance measured as a fraction of the V-apex-to-hem-point span. Render: apex y=500, hem point y=1105 (span 605); top button y=608 lands 0.179 down. The top button sits roughly twice as far below the neckline apex, leaving a visible panel of empty cloth between the V and the first button.
errors.expected: Top button set immediately beneath the point where the two front edges converge, about 8 percent of the apex-to-hem span below the apex
errors.actual: Top button about 18 percent of the apex-to-hem span below the apex, with a bare gap of cloth between
errors.correction: Place the top button directly under the V apex so the buttoning line begins at the moment the two front edges meet, with the button head nearly grazing the convergence point.

errors.description: The pocket-line to second-button relationship is inverted. Drawing: welt centres y=628, second button y=685 - the button falls 57px BELOW the pocket line. errors.actual: Middle button sitting just above the welt line, with the welts pushed down toward the third button
errors.correction: Set the waist besom welts so their line passes just above the middle button, with the welt opening roughly one button-diameter higher than the middle button's centre.

errors.description: Welt rake. Drawing's left welt runs y=590 outer to y=665 inner across a 300px span - outer-end-high rake of roughly 13-14 degrees. Render's welts rise only 8-10px across 195px, roughly 3 degrees, reading as near-horizontal.

errors.actual: Waist besom welts nearly horizontal at roughly 3 degrees
errors.correction: Rake each waist besom so the outer end sits clearly higher than the inner end, about 13 degrees off horizontal, following the hip line.

errors.description: A necktie occupies the V opening. The drawing shows the neckline opening empty, and for a front-style option the shape of the V is part of what is being sold. The tie covers no button and hides no front edge, so the option still reads.
errors.expected: Open neckline showing the shirt front so the V of the front style is unobstructed
errors.actual: A charcoal necktie filling the V opening
errors.correction: Show the shirt front open under the neckline with the collar visible and no tie, so the full V of the front edges reads against plain white shirting.
